basic_info.description: This is an impeccably renovated classic Mediterranean home nestled on a prime corner lot in the sought-after Westwood Highlands neighborhood. This elegant two-level residence seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern luxury, offering an inviting and functional living space.    The main level features three spacious bedrooms and two beautifully appointed full baths. The sunken living room has an abundance of light facing south with a beautiful tear drop primary window with custom shutters. There is a large formal dining room adjacent to the entry way, also featuring the classic wood trim and beautiful hardwood floors that appoint the the entire main level. The heart of the home is the stunning chef's kitchen, meticulously designed with quality appliances and custom finishes, making it a culinary enthusiast's dream. The kitchen is complete with both a breakfast bar and breakfast area. Classic bathrooms on this level complement the home's original character while providing modern comfort. The lower level leads to a generous family room, perfect for gatherings and relaxation. A cozy fireplace is the focal point while French doors lead out to a serene garden, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. This level also offers a  modern bath and access to the large garage.
